# PortableMind MCP tool reference

PortableMind is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Every tool below is callable by any
MCP client — Claude Code, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, custom agents —
acting as the connected user, in that user's workspace, with that user's permissions.

- **Endpoint:** `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp` (OAuth 2.1, or a personal MCP token as a Bearer header) —
  see [connect.md](../connect.md).
- **Narrow the tool set** with `?categories=data,conversation` or
  `?tools=general_crud_tool,apply_status_tool` on the endpoint URL. Fewer tools per request
  means fewer tokens per turn.
- **Never send `tenant_id`.** The server resolves the workspace from your credential.
- **Recipes** for the calls agents most often get wrong: [recipes.md](../recipes.md).

93 tools in 18 categories.
